nodes.title: Krea2 Prompt Wizard — Basic
widgets_values:
## Krea2 Prompt Wizard — Basic

The `Krea2 Prompt Wizard` node emits a `FINAL_PROMPT` STRING.

Connect it to a `CLIPTextEncode` node, then a KSampler, and render.

The wizard also exposes `PLAIN_PROMPT`, per-category outputs, `TRACE_JSON`, `STATE_JSON`, and `WARNINGS` for inspection.
